headline: Kings’ Kevin Fiala to make season debut vs. Islanders
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Kings winger Kevin Fiala will make his season debut against the Islanders. Per the report, he has been out since suffering a leg injury while representing Switzerland at the 2026 Winter Olympics.

Los Angeles could use him. The Kings are 5-9-2 with 12 points in 16 games, yet they've actually held up on the chance count: their share of expected goals (the quality of chances taken versus allowed) is 51 percent, and 51 percent at five-on-five too. The problem is finishing and saves. LAK is 5.5 goals below what its shots should have produced, and its goaltending is 6.4 goals worse than expected (goals saved above expected), so the record looks worse than the play. A scoring forward returning helps close that first gap. The power play is a place to watch, at 0.79 expected goals per game so far this season. The opponent has its own story: NYI sits at 45.8 percent of expected goals, but its goalies are 11.1 goals better than expected, which has covered for it.
